_about: Numbers and mappings for web/src/world/adapters/food.ts (Phase 5 adapter 2). The food rows, the Keeps column and the ration come from files/pirate-ship/body/data/nutrition.json; the goods from data/pirate-ship/economy/goods.json; this file holds only what neither carries. Fixtures are listed in web/src/world/FIXTURES.md (F-FD-*).

week.source: the ration table's own column: 'Per week'

lb.source: avoirdupois pound, exact since the international yard and pound agreement of 1959; the ration table counts in lb

goodOverrides.why: The food row names GOODS row 23, which has no engine good; the good 'Salt beef and pork' (row 22) is the salted meat the recipes make. Rex confirms (F-FD-2).
